question: Who among the following has been appointed as the Chairperson of National Commission for Women (NCW), in October 2024?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vijaya Kishore Rahatkar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Vijaya Kishore Rahatkar** was appointed as the Chairperson of the National Commission for Women (NCW) in October 2024.
 
• She has previously served in prominent leadership roles, including as the **President of BJP Mahila Morcha**.
 
• Her appointment reflects her extensive experience in advocacy for women's rights and empowerment in India.
 
• The NCW is a statutory body established under the **National Commission for Women Act, 1990**, tasked with addressing issues affecting women.
 
• The Chairperson plays a critical role in shaping policies and initiatives to ensure gender equality and protection of women's rights.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **National Commission for Women (NCW)**

 
 
• The NCW was established in January 1992 under the **National Commission for Women Act, 1990**.
 
• Its primary role is to **review legal provisions** to safeguard women's rights and recommend measures for their effective implementation.
 
• The NCW also investigates specific complaints of violations of women's rights and monitors the functioning of laws relating to women.
 
• The commission aims to promote equality and fair treatment of women in various spheres, including employment and societal roles.
 
 
 
• **Chairperson's Role**
 
 
• The Chairperson leads the commission in formulating policies and strategies to address women's issues.
 
• They represent the NCW in interactions with government bodies, NGOs, and international organizations.
 
• The Chairperson is responsible for ensuring that the commission fulfills its mandate under the law.
 
 
 
• **Key Functions of NCW**
 
 
• Safeguarding rights guaranteed to women under the Constitution of India.
 
• Reviewing existing legislation and proposing amendments to address contemporary challenges faced by women.
 
• Creating awareness campaigns and programs to promote gender equality.
 
• Investigating complaints regarding women's issues and taking up cases with relevant authorities.
 
 
 
• **Previous Chairpersons**
 
 
• The NCW has had several notable leaders, including **Rekha Sharma**, who served as Chairperson before Vijaya Kishore Rahatkar.
 
• Past Chairpersons have contributed significantly to landmark initiatives and advocacy efforts for women's rights.
